$comment: Specialist actions (ruleset v0; spec S2 section 14, settled 2026-11-07; numbers are proposals). Settled in the brief: only specialist types shape the world, each by its own fixed rule (2026-10-10); actions show as markers on the regiment's lane; edits write the shared grids; every result leaves gaps for every class and stays clearable (each edit batch passes the reachability check or is skipped); charges are lost when the regiment is wiped or routs; the 100 m rule binds the god, not soldiers. common: an enemy outline within pauseWhenEnemyWithinMm pauses the action, the specialists fall back fallBackMm and resume after resumeAfterClearTicks clear. dig-ditch (Spademen, D5): a line of up to maxPoints the player draws, within withinZoneMm of the own zone, starting within startWithinMm of the regiment, at most mmPer10Soldiers per 10 soldiers long; profile: a 1-cell ditch ditchDepthMm below the ground, bermCells untouched, a 1-cell bank bankHeightMm high on the regiment's side; sectionCellsAlong cells per ticksPerSection with the whole regiment, scaled by living / starting soldiers but never below minRatePermille. fill-crossing (Fascine Carriers): triggered when the regiment's own foot path, within aheadMm of its officer, enters cells belowRimMm under the rim, mud of mudAtLeast or water waterMinMm to waterMaxMm deep; fills a strip widthCells wide, at most maxLengthCells long, through to the first cells open for wheeled, one bundle (bundleRaiseMm, up to the lower rim) per ticksPerBundle, one bundle per living soldier; filled cells lose their mud. A filled cell where depth x flow speed reaches washoutDepthSpeed (mm*m/s) for washoutTicks loses washoutLossMm. The fascine soil's churn (S2) waits for soils that change in battle. Engineers' bridgework and clearing follow below; the Pontoon Train and Crossing Marshals join in M5 item 4, the Drovers with herds (item 7).

actions.$comment: Engineers' bridgework (S2 14.7, brief 2026-10-11): a trestle over a gap closed to wheeled on the army's path, at most maxGapMm along it, looked for up to aheadMm ahead: one segment (load.json trestle: 2 cells along, 2 wide, on the bed, wood) per ticksPerSegment for timberMmPerSegment of timber, the deck at the near bank's height; repairs to a standing wooden segment within repairWithinMm below repairBelowPermille, repairPermillePerS up to repairUpToPermille, timberMmPer250Permille per 250 permille restored (the repair replaces the rotten planks, ending any Rot under way on it). Charges: timberMmPer40Soldiers of timber per 40 soldiers. The trigger reads strength, never load or strain (brief 2026-10-09). Attackers build on their path; a defender's retreat-route trestle waits for the regiment AI's retreat routes (M7).

Engineers' clearing (S2 14.7): a blocker within withinMm of the officer and within nearPathMm of the army's path ahead is cleared in its time (boulder boulderTicks; felled trees and wrecks join with item 7), drawn from a pool of ticksPer40Soldiers per 40 soldiers; the blocker is unstamped (its cells open and drop to the ground under it).
